result.title: NuJEV: Structured Visual Judgments for Consistent Nuclei Quantification
result.summary: Nuclear quantification requires locating and typing nuclei, beyond generating a count. Inspired by Jev's structured decisions in place of free-form generation, we introduce NuJEV for nuclear perception in Qwen3-VL-2B. We jointly train visual LoRA and a parallel head to predict nuclear presence, centers, and types. One image encoding feeds both the nuclear head and original language decoder. The decoder interprets region and type requests, with counts computed from the predicted nuclei. On 2,732 PanNuke test images, NuJEV achieves a five-query mean absolute error ($\mathrm{MAE}_5$) of 1.844 overall and 5.268 on dense images, with localization/typed F1 of 0.816/0.682. A matched encoder ablation shows 41.0\% lower dense error with visual adaptation. For language requests, NuJEV reduces request MAE by 76.2\% relative to direct generation. Our code will be released as open source.

AI.brief_summary: NuJEV 在 Qwen3-VL-2B 上联合训练视觉 LoRA 与一个并行头，从同一图像编码同时预测细胞核的存在、中心与类型，语言解码器则解析区域和类型请求并由预测核计算计数，在 PanNuke 上报告计数误差与定位/分型 F1。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化头读出替代自由文本生成」的设定（请求 MAE 相对直接生成下降 76.2%）可作为核查 VLM 生成路径是否丢失细粒度视觉信息、以及结构化旁路与解码器共用编码的对照线索，但论文本身不研究推理过程或 latent 状态。
